{{Quote|Attacking the queen conventionally would be suicide, but my... ever thoughtful master had me devise something to assist you.|Doctor Gleelan, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:DwtQ" />}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Gleelan''' was an enslaved [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who was in the employ of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Pirrell]] used Gleelan, who did not speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], to help a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] aggravate a [[Kag'areth Queen's Nest|nest]] of [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]].<ref name="TOR:DwtQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Gleelan appears in the Bounty Hunter mission "Down With the Queen" on Balmorra in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:DwtQ" />
